description: This file defines a Retrofit API interface called 'ImagesApi' for interacting with image-related endpoints under the '/images' path of the Fineract API. It declares methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting images associated with various entities, using annotations to specify HTTP methods, paths, parameters, and multipart handling.

classes.name: ImagesApi
classes.description: An interface defining Retrofit HTTP methods for image management endpoints including create, get, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Sends a POST request to upload a new image for a specified entity type and ID, including the image file as multipart data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Sends a GET request to retrieve the image for a specified entity, with optional parameters for maximum width, height, and output format.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Sends a PUT request to update an existing image for a specified entity, with new image data as multipart.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to remove the image associated with a specified entity.
